# Elemental Bond

Elemental Bond is a web-based, BaZi-inspired Five Elements personality and relationship compatibility test. It provides a free simplified preview and clearly separates that preview from paid full-report content.

## Core pages
- https://elemental.bond/ — free single-person core-element reading
- https://elemental.bond/compatibility — free two-person relationship preview
- https://elemental.bond/faq — methodology, limitations, and common questions
- https://elemental.bond/compare/co-star-vs-elemental-bond — neutral Co–Star comparison
- https://elemental.bond/compare/the-pattern-vs-elemental-bond — neutral The Pattern comparison

## Method and limitations
The product draws vocabulary and interpretive structure from BaZi (Four Pillars) and the Chinese Five Elements tradition. The instant free calculation is a simplified pattern classification, not a complete professional Four Pillars chart. The service is intended for reflection and entertainment and is not a scientifically validated psychological or predictive assessment.

## Commercial disclosure
The validation release offers a $24.90 USD one-time compatibility report. A future membership is described as early access only; no recurring subscription is charged by the validation release.
